task: W4-C3 — CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY

scope.slice: W4-C3: CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY ONLY
scope.historicalIntentContract: Durable internal pending request binding active reservation effective version to accepted-offer target quote

migration.strategy: Additive schema extension creating canonical_reservation_modification_requests table with composite foreign keys to W4-C1 sealed revisions and stays_quotes; atomic routine canonical_request_reservation_modification with authorization-before-replay order, wall-clock expiry check post-row-lock, deterministic command fingerprinting, and restricted execution role encho_modification_issuer

columns.reservation_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES canonical_reservations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
columns.target_quote_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES stays_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tableSchema.shapeConstraint: chk_modification_request_source_version_shape enforces ((source_effective_version = 1 AND source_revision_id IS NULL) OR (source_effective_version >= 2 AND source_revision_id IS NOT NULL))
tableSchema.immutability: Trigger canonical_reservation_modification_requests_immutable unconditionally rejects UPDATE or DELETE
tableSchema.rowLevelSecurity: Enabled and forced: ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

functionSignature.name: canonical_request_reservation_modification
functionSignature.returns: TABLE (request_id UUID, reservation_id UUID, command_id UUID, holder_principal TEXT, source_effective_version INT, source_revision_id UUID, target_quote_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, replayed BOOLEAN)
functionSignature.security: VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp SET row_security = on
functionSignature.roleModel: REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE TO encho_modification_issuer

architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step1_inputValidation: Rejects NULLs, malformed principals, source version < 1
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step2_reservationLock: SELECT * FROM canonical_reservations WHERE id = target_reservation_id FOR UPDATE
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step5_fingerprintComputation: Deterministic SHA-256 over canonical JSONB payload (command_type, reservation_id, authenticated_principal, expected_source_effective_version, target_quote_id)
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step6_replayCheck: Authorization-before-replay order: verifies existing command_id under locked reservation; if fingerprint matches, returns stored result with replayed = true BEFORE mutable gates; if fingerprint differs, raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step9_mutableGateTargetQuote: stays_quotes must exist, quote_kind = 'ACCEPTED_OFFER', matching holder principal, matching listing_id
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step10_mutableGateOfferPointer: Locks sellable_offers FOR UPDATE; verifies quote_row.offer_revision matches offer_ptr.current_accepted_revision and public_disposition = 'ACCEPTED'; checks static listing/room coherence
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step11_mutableGateWallClockExpiry: Checks stays_quotes.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() strictly AFTER acquiring reservation and offer row locks
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step12_atomicInsertion: Inserts row with ON CONFLICT (command_id) DO NOTHING; handles unique_violation race safety

casesVerified: A. ACTIVE Encho Direct V1 + fresh quote + matching holder: succeeds, persists row, zero inventory mutation, zero target holds, zero revisions
B. Unknown reservation rejected: MODIFICATION_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND
C. Authenticated caller !== reservation holder rejected: MODIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED
D. Authenticated caller !== target quote holder rejected: MODIFICATION_QUOTE_HOLDER_MISMATCH
E. CANCELLED reservation rejected: MODIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT
F. Quote expired rejected: MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
G. Quote expiry DURING LOCK WAIT evaluated with post-wait wall clock: MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
H. External-origin reservation rejected: MODIFICATION_ORIGIN_NOT_SUPPORTED
I. Authenticated caller !== reservation holder rejected: MODIFICATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED
J. Quote kind != ACCEPTED_OFFER rejected: MODIFICATION_QUOTE_KIND_INVALID
K. Different listing target quote rejected: MODIFICATION_LISTING_MISMATCH
L. Quote / offer static incoherence rejected: MODIFICATION_QUOTE_INCOHERENT
M. Superseded offer revision rejected: MODIFICATION_OFFER_SUPERSEDED
N. Current accepted revision succeeds
O. Exact idempotent replay returns same stored result: replayed = true
P. Replay after quote expiry succeeds without re-evaluating expiry: replayed = true
Q. Replay after offer succession succeeds without re-evaluating: replayed = true
R. Replay after lifecycle change succeeds without re-evaluating: replayed = true
S. Same command + changed target quote -> conflict: MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
T. Same command + changed expected version -> conflict: MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
U. Stale expected source version rejected: MODIFICATION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH
V. Sealed V2 source revision persists exact source_revision_id FK
W. Unsealed V2 source cannot be referenced by request row: FK constraint rejects
X. Modification request table is immutable: UPDATE/DELETE rejected by trigger
Y. Zero inventory mutation verified across all operations
Z. Concurrent identical commands serialize: exactly one row inserted, second replays
AA. Concurrent different commands serialize without race corruption
AB. Negative role probes: PUBLIC, web, worker roles denied EXECUTE; issuer restricted
AC. Zero modification writer in pg_proc: no routine capable of publishing revisions
